description: File uploads on a real file input: a drag-and-drop dropzone (single or multiple, with a file list and remove), a compact button, and an image or avatar picker with preview. Checks type and size in the browser from accept and max-size, and with upload-url uploads each file straight away with a progress bar and submits the stored ids. Works with Livewire wire:model.

consider.note: `accept` and `max-size` only check in the browser. Validate on the server with `File` rules or `mimes:` and `max:`, which read the file's content, not its name.
Store under a generated name on a private disk, never in `public/`. Serve files through a route that authorizes, or a temporary URL, and avoid serving SVG or HTML from your own domain.
With `upload-url`, the form submits ids: check each belongs to the person before attaching it.
A picked file may never be submitted. Consider a scheduled job that deletes uploads nobody claimed after a day, or storage keeps growing.
Make thumbnails, scan files or extract text in a queued job, not in the upload request, so a slow file doesn't hold a worker.
